images.filename: Arial View Of Downtown Oklahoma City 8.20.2022 002.jpg
images.caption:
Aerial View Of Downtown Oklahoma City. Taken as the Southwest Flight I was own started to turn in to land at Will Rogers World Airport. This image was taken facing East as the plane started to make its final approach at Will Rogers.
The image colors levels were changed with the Level Curve Editor before the colors were saturated slightly to enhance the image before the unmask sharpen filter was applied, all within GIMP. The final image was then downscaled from 16MP to 7.6MP.

Original photo taken August 20, 2022 using a Kodak PIXPRO AZ252 Digital Camera at 16MP.

images.filename: Arial View Of the Southern Tip Of Downtown Oklahoma City.jpg
images.caption:
Aerial View Of the Southern Tip Of Downtown Oklahoma City. Taken as the Southwest Flight I was own started to turn in to land at Will Rogers World Airport. The image includes Devon Towner, BOK Park Plaza, Paycom Center, Prairie Surf Studios. The image cuts off at Scissortail Park and the Oklahoma City Convention Center. Oklahoma City Blvd is very easily seen and recognizable in this photo.
The image colors levels were changed with the Level Curve Editor before the colors were saturated slightly to enhance the image before the unmask sharpen filter was applied, all within GIMP. The final image was then downscaled from 16MP to 7.1MP.

Original photo taken August 20, 2022 using a Kodak PIXPRO AZ252 Digital Camera at 16MP.

images.filename: Oklahoma City Streetcar - green car on 4th Street passing First United Methodist Church.jpg
images.caption: Green-and-white car No. 201806 of the Oklahoma City Streetcar system eastbound on NW 4th Street just east of Robinson Avenue, passing the First United Methodist Church.  Car 201806 was built by Brookville Equipment Corporation for the OKC Streetcar system, which opened in 2018.  The historic church building was built in 1903 as the First Episcopal Methodist Church.  It was damaged in the 1995 bombing of the nearby Murrah Federal Building and was subsequently restored.
